description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Your role


**Key Responsibilities**

**Middleware Administration \& Automation (Primary Focus)**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for middleware platforms using **Ansible, Python, and YAML** .
* Automate middleware provisioning, installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and decommissioning.
* Build reusable automation frameworks for:
	+ IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS)
	+ IBM Liberty
	+ IBM HTTP Server (IHS)
	+ Apache Tomcat
	+ Oracle WebLogic
	+ IIS
	+ Apache HTTP Server
* Implement automated health checks, compliance validation, configuration drift detection, and self\-healing capabilities.
* Convert manual middleware operational tasks into fully automated workflows and pipelines.
* Develop runbooks and automation standards for enterprise middleware operations.

**DevOps \& CI/CD**

* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using:
	+ Azure DevOps
	+ GitHub Actions
	+ Jenkins
	+ VS Code
* Automate application deployments across middleware environments.
* Support release management, deployment orchestration, rollback mechanisms, and automated validations.
* Integrate infrastructure and middleware configurations into Infrastructure\-as\-Code and Configuration\-as\-Code frameworks.
* Embed security, governance, and compliance controls within CI/CD workflows.
* Collaborate with application, QA, and infrastructure teams to improve deployment reliability and speed.

**Middleware Platform Operations**

* Manage and support enterprise middleware environments across Development, QA, UAT, and Production.
* Perform middleware installation, upgrades, migrations, and patch management.
* Configure:
	+ Application Servers
	+ Web Servers
	+ Messaging Systems
	+ Load Balancer Integrations
	+ SSL/TLS Security
	+ Reverse Proxy Configurations
* Implement clustering, load balancing, session persistence, and HA solutions.
* Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and resource optimization.
* Troubleshoot platform\-level incidents and complex production issues.

**Cloud \& Infrastructure Operations**

* Automate deployment and configuration of middleware workloads on Azure and hybrid infrastructures.
* Support middleware services running on Windows and Linux platforms.
* Utilize **VMware Aria Automation and Aria Operations** for infrastructure automation, monitoring, provisioning, and operational governance.
* Support containerized middleware deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift where applicable.
* Ensure platform availability, reliability, and security compliance.

**Monitoring, Reliability \& Security**

* Implement proactive monitoring and automated remediation for middleware components.
* Configure and manage:
	+ Application Monitoring
	+ JVM Monitoring
	+ Log Aggregation
	+ Alerting Frameworks
	+ Performance Dashboards
	+ VMware Aria Operations
* Conduct root cause analysis and develop permanent fixes through automation.
* Implement security hardening, certificate management, encryption standards, and access controls.
* Support audit and compliance requirements.

**Operating Systems**

* Automation\-first mindset.
* Ability to work independently and manage critical production environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
* Customer\-focused and outcome\-driven approach.
Strong documentation and knowledge\-sharing capabilities.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Principal Devops Lead
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


As a DevOps Principal Lead at Ameriprise you will play a key role in the DevSecOps team. You will be part of a team responsible for the engineering and maintenance of the enterprise Build and Release engineering solutions and platforms. In this role you will often collaborate with partners in other lines of business providing build solutions when new applications are introduced, or changes are made to existing applications. You will help drive the optimization of technology operations though automation and solution delivery, system/services performance monitoring and solving problems.  

  

Engineering and consulting  

* Design, build and implement solutions that support infrastructure needs
* Consult on DevSecOps needs from various application/line of business partners and Aid teams in finding build automation requirements, design, implement CICD solutions.
* Develop re\-usable/plug\&play patterns and solutions for CICD pipelines.
* Design, build and implement Automation and systems integration across different build platforms
* Document and socialize CICD patterns, solutions, and best practices.


We are seeking a highly experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and support enterprise\-scale DevOps platforms and CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in automation, release management, DevSecOps, and platform engineering, with expertise in building and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable software delivery processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise CI/CD pipelines and deployment frameworks.
* Administer, support, and optimize the organization's DevOps toolchain and development platforms.
* Develop automation solutions and reusable frameworks to improve operational efficiency and developer productivity.
* Implement and promote DevSecOps best practices, ensuring security and quality are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Establish and enforce source control, branching, release management, and deployment standards.
* Integrate code quality, security scanning, artifact management, and compliance controls into CI/CD workflows.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, security, and QA teams to streamline software delivery and improve platform reliability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline, deployment, and platform\-related issues.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across DevOps processes, tooling, and governance.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or related disciplines.
* Hands\-on experien**ce** with Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory, JFrog Xray, Jira, and Confluence.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise CI/CD solutions and deployment automation frameworks.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, and Bash.
* Proven experience with source control management, branching strategies, repository administration, and release management processes.
* Strong understanding of DevOps and DevSecOps principles, CI/CD architecture, software delivery lifecycle (SDLC), artifact management, security and vulnerability management, platform governance, and compliance controls.
* Experience integrating quality gates, security scanning, and compliance requirements into automated deployment pipelines.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale DevOps platforms in regulated environments, preferably within financial services.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, governance, security, and risk management practices.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

 **In\-Office Collaboration**


We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Copy)
description:
Build the platform other engineers deploy on.
  
PrismHR is the HR, payroll, and benefits platform used by employer\-services organizations across the United States, backed by Vensure Employer Solutions. Our platform serves clients whose employees get paid on what we ship, which makes reliability engineering here consequential rather than abstract.
  
You will help design, build, and operate secure, scalable, highly available cloud infrastructure on Azure and just as importantly, you will make it usable by engineering teams through infrastructure as code, CI/CD automation, and container orchestration. Concretely: designing, deploying, and managing Azure infrastructure across AKS, virtual networks, load balancers, storage accounts, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and IAM, with real attention to cost optimization, capacity planning, and performance. Building and maintaining Terraform modules that provision Azure infrastructure repeatably and under version control, enforcing IaC standards and environment parity across dev, QA, and production, and working with security and architecture to embed compliance into IaC pipelines.
  
You will operate AKS clusters for production and non\-production workloads, container deployments, scaling, rolling upgrades, resiliency patterns, and troubleshoot cluster, node, pod, and networking problems to keep availability high. You will design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and application deployment, automate build, test, release, and rollback, and integrate security scans, quality gates, and infrastructure validation into those pipelines. You will implement monitoring, alerting, and logging, participate in incident response and root cause analysis, and drive the post\-incident improvements that actually stop the same thing happening twice. You will work closely with Software Engineering, QA, Security, and Architecture as a shared owner of production rather than a downstream service desk.
  
**You will need:** • 4\+ years of hands\-on DevOps or platform engineering • Strong Azure: AKS, virtual networks, load balancers, storage accounts, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, IAM • Terraform — building and maintaining your own modules, not only running someone else's • Kubernetes in production, ideally AKS: deployments, scaling, rolling upgrades, resiliency, and real troubleshooting • CI/CD pipeline design and ownership, including automated rollback • Monitoring, alerting, and logging, plus genuine incident response experience • Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation • Collaborative instincts across engineering, QA, security, and architecture
  
**Nice to have:** security scanning and compliance automation in pipelines · cost optimization with measured results · Azure Policy and governance · scripting depth in Python, PowerShell, or Bash · payroll, HCM, or other regulated\-domain SaaS experience. The schedule: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM EAT, Monday to Friday. On\-call, stated plainly: this role participates in an on\-call rotation. We would rather you weigh that honestly now than discover it in month two, and we are happy to walk through what the rotation actually looks like during the process. Competitive compensation, health coverage, certification and learning support, and a platform role with genuine scope to shape how engineering ships. Apply now.
  
  

\#VensureHRIndia
  
\#LI\-PROMOTED
  
\#LI\-Hybrid
  
  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Cloud Devops Module Lead
description:
**Company Description** **About Sopra Steria**  

Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end\-to\-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in\-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5\.6 billion.  

**The world is how we shape it.**

 **Job Description**  

Experience

* **4\+ years of relevant experience** in Cloud, DevOps, Infrastructure Automation, or related areas.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud automation and DevOps solutions.


Role Overview


We are looking for a **Cloud Automation Engineer** to design, implement, and maintain scalable automation solutions across cloud and containerized environments. The candidate will work on infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and deployment automation while ensuring reliability, security, and operational efficiency.


Must Have

* Strong hands\-on experience in **designing and implementing Docker and Kubernetes** environments.
* Experience with **Terraform** for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including designing and managing cloud infrastructure.
* Good understanding and practical experience with **CI/CD tools**, including:
* Jenkins
* Maven
* GitLab CI/CD
* Experience with **Infrastructure and configuration automation using Ansible**.
* Strong scripting knowledge in one or more languages such as:
* **Bash/Shell**
* **Python**
* **Groovy**
* Other scripting languages is an advantage.
* Good understanding of DevOps practices, automation principles, version control, and deployment processes.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues across build, deployment, container, and infrastructure environments.


Good to Have

* Sound knowledge of **AWS and/or Microsoft Azure** cloud components and services.
* Hands\-on experience with common cloud services such as compute, storage, networking, IAM, monitoring, and container services.
* Experience in **Linux system administration**, including system configuration, troubleshooting, networking, and performance monitoring.
* Knowledge of cloud security and best practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/DevOps environment.


Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain **cloud infrastructure automation** using Terraform and Ansible.
* Design and manage **Docker containers and Kubernetes\-based deployments**.
* Develop and maintain robust **CI/CD pipelines** using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Maven, and related tools.
* Automate repetitive infrastructure and deployment activities using scripting and configuration\-management tools.
* Collaborate with development, QA, security, and operations teams to improve software delivery and deployment processes.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD issues and implement long\-term solutions.
* Support cloud infrastructure across **AWS/Azure** environments where applicable.
* Follow DevOps, automation, security, scalability, and reliability best practices.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation, reduce manual effort, and increase deployment efficiency.


Preferred Skills

**Docker \| Kubernetes \| Terraform \| Ansible \| Jenkins \| GitLab CI/CD \| Maven \| Bash \| Python \| Groovy \| AWS \| Azure \| Linux \| DevOps \| Infrastructure as Code**


Total Experience Expected: 04\-06 years

 **Qualifications**  

Education


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

 **Additional Information**
